name: hardware_startup
archetype: Consumer hardware startup product launch site
market: Tech-savvy early adopters, crowdfunding backers, tech press, consumer electronics buyers
density: Apple-influenced but more startup-gritty. Full-screen product sections — each feature section is 100vh on dark background. Technical specs in a full-width dark table (#1C1C1C rows alternating with #222222) with 2 columns: property name (left, #888888 label) and value (right, white bold). Pre-order countdown timer in large 48px monospace. Product rotation: CSS keyframe animation rotateY(0deg→360deg) on 12s loop, giving the impression of a 3D spinning product showcase.
nav_style: Dark minimal nav. Product name/logo left. Nav: Features, Specs, Compare, Story, Press. Right: Pre-order price + CTA button. Shipping date shown near CTA. Cart icon.
commercial_model: Direct-to-consumer hardware. Pre-orders with deposit. Crowdfunding campaign alumni (Kickstarter/Indiegogo badge). First batch limited quantity. Early bird pricing countdown. Referral program for extra discount.
color_palette: Premium dark theme: near-black (#111111) or deep space grey (#1C1C1C). Brushed metal silver (#CACACA) for product photography tones. Accent: electric blue (#007AFF, Apple-adjacent) or warm amber (#FF9F0A). White (#FFFFFF) text. Clean, premium, hardware-appropriate.
typography: SF Pro adjacent or Inter — clean system-font philosophy. Product name in a bold 72-96px condensed face. Spec names in all-caps small labels. Numbers (specs like 48MP, 5000mAh) in large tabular bold. Body copy in 16px clean sans-serif.

pages.title: Home
pages.description: Full-screen product hero on dark background. Product name large. One-line value proposition. Key specs callouts: three most impressive numbers. Pre-order CTA with countdown. Reviews embargo note.

pages.title: Features
pages.description: Full-screen feature sections one after another. Each feature gets a full viewport: product photo, feature name, description, key differentiator callout. Scroll-through storytelling format.

pages.title: Technical Specs
pages.description: Complete specifications table. Sections: Display, Processor, Battery, Camera, Connectivity, Materials, Dimensions, Sensors. Full detail, no marketing-speak. Export spec sheet PDF link.

pages.title: Compare
pages.description: Side-by-side comparison table with 2-3 competitor products. Key specs comparison with checkmarks and X marks. Price per feature value calculation. 'Our product wins' highlighted in accent color.

pages.title: Our Story
pages.description: Founder letter. Problem they were solving. Journey from prototype to product. Workshop/manufacturing photos. Team section. Why they built this over traditional jobs. Community of early supporters.
